anchor.problem: Fixed-placement pin-access selection repeatedly solves a finite pair-conflict model; complete future feasibility may be expensive to represent, while truncated history is insufficient in general.
anchor.engineering_user: Detailed-routing developer maintaining a pin-access engine on fixed legal cell placement.
anchor.downstream_need: Reduce actual complete detailed-route latency at matched correctness and downstream quality, with practitioner-validated absolute value; no proxy-only success.
anchor.causal_mechanism: Compile exact residual forbidden-domain signatures of route-choice prefixes, merging only continuation-equivalent states and retaining query-labelled transitions before enabling masks.
mechanism_invariants: Fixed netlist, placement, cell masters, tracks, technology, fixed obstacles and route candidate domain.
Complete declared negative pair-conflict model; no claim beyond that model without independent geometry checking.
All actual construction, query, canonicalization, failed and fallback work charged.
Use native incrementalSAT and generic elimination/assignment-frontier comparators, not only obsolete local-historyDP.
Unchanged base graph and actual query count required for amortization; graph/domain/technology changes invalidate compiled states.
UNKNOWN on limits, independent downstream DRC/connectivity/extractionSTA before deployment claims.
forbidden_pivots: Release/reroute otherwise legal blocker nets or claim inherited EDA-0001 timing repair.
Move/resize/replace cells, add new access routes or advanced rule support to rescue this representation claim.
Treat genericSAT, variable elimination, decision diagrams, hashing or fallback composition as original without a supported nontrivial distinction.
Replace whole-flow latency and correctness with state count, solver-only time, HPWL or invented query frequency.
Weaken native solver reuse, query objectives or data/PDK conditions to manufacture advantage.

combination_drift.rationale: Initial separate-topic anchor; known-CSP equivalence explicitly unresolved, not concealed by adding methods. Zero drift does not imply nontrivial contribution.

demand_drift.rationale: Initial need is complete routing latency at correctness/quality; unvalidated value is retained as blocking, not replaced with a proxy.

revision_assessment.reason: Initial EDA-0003 anchor, not an anchor-preserving revision of EDA-0001. No inherited signatures or acceptance.

resurrection_conditions: A supported nontrivial distinction from generic residual compilation and currentFastPass.
Measured actual solver share and validated user latency threshold.
Representative independent design families, full oracle/resource pins and new allocation.
Matching unchanged-science/tasklist P/C consents and independent verifier readiness.
